close_reason: Moved validate_and_normalize_keywords doc to the function; FORBIDDEN_KEYWORD_CHARS has no doc block
description: At line 1176 in email.rs the doc comment for build_email_from_create is immediately followed (at line 1183) by a second doc block (/// Validate and normalize a raw keyword map ...) that describes validate_and_normalize_keywords but is attached to the FORBIDDEN_KEYWORD_CHARS constant instead of the function. The result is that build_email_from_create's doc comment appears to be cut off mid-sentence, and validate_and_normalize_keywords at line 1197 has no visible doc comment. A reader will misread the function contract. The second doc block should be moved to be the doc comment of validate_and_normalize_keywords.
title: email.rs: build_email_from_create doc comment is split/overwritten mid-function
